title: Restored-record id bindings and helpers still call the record id a hash
outcome: Restored-record id bindings and helpers still call the record id a hash
acceptance: The export binding in src/storage/graph_snapshot.rs, latest_restored_record_hash (src/storage/work/query.rs) and its caller in src/storage/work/completion/child_barriers.rs, and the stored_hash/hash labels in src/storage/work/completion/projections.rs name a restored record's id as an id or record id, not a hash, with behavior unchanged
